facts.text: Deadly Mile High Club premiered on Lifetime on Saturday, May 2, 2020, at 8 PM. Writer-director Doug Campbell made it as one of dozens of TV thrillers in his career.
Allison McAtee, who plays flight instructor Tanya, took several months of real flying lessons to prepare for the role, and posted photos of herself flying over mountains.
Allison McAtee, who plays flight instructor Tanya, captioned a pre-shoot biplane photo with Kelly McGillis, Top Gun and Holly Hunter hashtags, channeling aviation-movie heroines.
Diane Robin, who plays Annie's bulldozing mother Margaret, also appeared in Paul Verhoeven's sci-fi classic RoboCop (1987).
Writer-director Doug Campbell shot his first Super-8 film at 14, studied under Sandy Mackendrick at Cal Arts, and won Best Director at the DVD Premiere Awards for his 2002 film The Tomorrow Man.
One reviewer singled out the kissing between Tanya (Allison McAtee) and student Jake (Marc Herrmann) as the film's most awkward stretch, and captioned a still 'sensual' to underline the contrast.
Allison McAtee's first professional job was two 2002 episodes of the soap One Life to Live. She later played Maggie Day on the series The Haves and the Have Nots.
Tanya's late copilot, Captain Jacob Mathews, shares a first name with her new student Jake Sherman. A reviewer noted this coincidence is the root of her fixation.
Jake's friend Tom, whose spare room he moves into, is talked about constantly but never appears on screen. One reviewer joked the film wasn't budgeted for him.
Tanya's first-aid kit lists chloroform. One reviewer noticed the movie plants it early, like a Chekhov's gun, so it can pay off later.
Rival stunt pilot Gonzo recruits students with two women in flight-attendant outfits. A reviewer joked holograms would have been a smarter, cheaper way to tail Tanya's students.
Gonzo says he's surprised Tanya's pilot's license was renewed after a fatal crash. Reviewers flagged the same plot hole, so the script is in on the joke.
Director Doug Campbell often makes as many as six Lifetime-style thrillers in a year. A blogger estimates Johnson Production Group, MarVista and Reel One made 400+ such movies in 15 years.
The film was reviewed in depth on episode 249 of the comedy podcast How Did This Get Made?, hosted by Paul Scheer, June Diane Raphael and Jason Mantzoukas.
Gonzo's Flight Academy, run by stunt pilot Damon K. Sperber's character, has the slogan 'Reckless But in a Fun, Cool Way Since 2005,' according to one reviewer.
Damon K. Sperber plays stunt pilot Captain Gonzo Rogers, who adores being himself. He later turned up in Ted (2024) and the series Daisy Jones & The Six.
Before playing Tanya, Allison McAtee appeared in Iron Man (2008) as 'Dubai Beauty' and had a recurring guest role on Showtime's Californication for two seasons.
The film shot around Southern California, including Upland, Riverside, Sherman Oaks, Valley Village and North Hollywood.
Director Doug Campbell is also known for Lifetime-style thrillers like Stalked by My Doctor (2015) and My Daughter's Ransom (2019).
Tanya's line "Houston, we have a problem" is a nod to Apollo 13 (1995), which gave that misquoted line to Tom Hanks.
Annie's neighbor Lindsey gushes that checking doorbell-camera footage is like CSI. The film officially references CSI: Crime Scene Investigation (2000).
The hot pink hat that gets Annie framed on neighbor Lindsey's doorbell footage reportedly costs just $11.99 on Amazon, according to one reviewer.
Annie's pink fedora became a fan obsession. The hosts of the I Love a Lifetime Movie podcast say the film is where the pink fedora fandom was born.
Continuity goof: during the Gulfstream tryst, Tanya wears a black bra, but moments later in the cockpit it has become a light-colored one.
The film was produced by Shadowbox Films Inc. with Robert Ballo as producer. Its cast also includes Connor Carlson as Wally and Ben Palacios as Captain Mathews, Tanya's late copilot.
Rotten Tomatoes lists no critic reviews for Deadly Mile High Club, only a 14% audience score from fewer than 50 ratings, and one viewer called it a 'schlocky, sexy, pseudo-suspenseful thriller.'
Reviewers found the final twist a surprise: after Jake confesses to sleeping with Tanya, his wife Annie (Anna Marie Dobbins) reveals she slept with 'my professor.'
